collection.description: Children notice differences in skin tones, hair textures, and facial features among families and visiting tribes.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Children notice differences in skin tones, hair textures, and facial features among families and visiting tribes.

choices.label: Invite Personal Stories Without Demanding Them
Explore How Sunlight and Environments Matter

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They learn that human variation has many overlapping patterns and does not define ability or worth.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (visitor), a visitor, volunteers a story about their family's journeys.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Another visitor declines to explain their appearance, and the children respect that.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child), a curious child, asks good questions about pigmentation and adaptation.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (adult) clarifies that simple environmental stories cannot explain every individual trait.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) recognizes they made a mistaken guess about someone's skills.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The group learns to ask what people enjoy rather than assuming from appearance.

a2__fx.name: Outcome A2
a2__fx.text: (child) compares relatives and delights in how family members can look different.
